svg.title: Self-evolution is a generate → verify → learn loop
svg.desc: Self-evolving language models generate candidates, use a verifier or critic to keep good examples, fine-tune, and repeat. STaR filters rationales by answer correctness and can rationalize failures; ReST alternates Grow and Improve; Constitutional AI uses critique/revision and AI feedback.

g.text: Self-evolution is a generate → verify → learn loop
The verifier is the source of signal; without it, the model can reinforce its own errors.
next round uses the updated model
Bad verification → bad examples survive → errors compound.
STaR: keep correct rationales; rationalize failures. ReST: Grow → Improve.
Constitutional AI: critique/revise, then learn from AI preference feedback.
